items.name: sage
items.title: Sage
items.description: Agent thinking states as a status chip: a pixel-art wizard at his desk who does whatever the agent is doing. One file, no dependencies, defines <sage-status>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sage is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /pixel-worlds/sage.js with a script tag, then use <sage-status state="thinking"></sage-status> and call el.set(state, label, detail). States: thinking, searching, reading, running, writing, waiting, done, failed. More: https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app

items.name: hoard
items.title: Hoard
items.description: A hold-to-delete button with a pixel-art dragon in it. Hold and the fire is the fill; hold to the end and it fires hoard:delete. One file, no dependencies, defines <hoard-button>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Hoard is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /pixel-worlds/hoard.js with a script tag, then use <hoard-button heading="Delete this project" warning="This can't be undone."></hoard-button> and listen for the hoard:delete event. More: https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app
